about: Areas for the optional 'Build map packs' GitHub workflow, which makes .pmtiles files and attaches them to a GitHub Release (not GitHub Pages, not the repository). Upload the files to Google Drive and list the links in the online sheet's MapPacks tab. bbox = [west, south, east, north] in degrees. maxzoom 15 is street detail; the app keeps zooming in using the same data. Each file must be under 2 GB.
